programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Argentina
programme.desc: Cita con la historia en Nueva York. España sueña con levantar la copa más bonita, la del Mundial, y añadir así la segunda estrella al escudo. Una finalísima ante Argentina que por primera vez enfrenta a los actuales campeones de Europa y de Sudamérica.

programme.title: DAZN Mundial
programme.desc: La gesta de los campeones del mundo se merece una fiesta por todo lo alto. Las calles de Madrid se vuelcan con los héroes de Nueva York que consiguieron tejer la segunda estrella en el escudo de la Selección Española.

programme.title: Revelado - Luis de la Fuente

programme.desc: Suivez des matchs du tournoi WTA de Hambourg, également appelé Hamburg European Open, classé en catégorie 250 sur le WTA Tour de tennis.

programme.title: Football : Coupe de France
programme.desc: C'est une affiche inédite qu'offre l'édition 2025/2026 de la Coupe de France entre Lens et Nice. Auteurs d'une saison exceptionnelle, les Lensois peuvent s'offrir un trophée qui couronnerait leur travail. Mais attention aux Niçois qui misent sur cette coupe pour sauver leur saison.

programme.title: Rugby : Champions Cup
programme.desc: Tenants du titre depuis leur victoire en 2025 contre les Northampton Saints, les joueurs de l'UBB sont de nouveau en finale de la Champions Cup contre les Irlandais du Leinster.

programme.title: Handball : Coupe de France masculine
programme.desc: Le Montpellier Handball et le HBC Nantes s'affrontent, à l'Accor Arena, pour la finale de la Coupe de France, dans une affiche de prestige. Les deux clubs se retrouvent pour la troisième fois de leur histoire en finale de cette compétition. Les deux précédentes confrontations avaient tourné à l'avantage des Nantais, vainqueurs face au MHB en 2017, puis en 2023.

programme.title: Raid des Alizées
programme.desc: Au-delà de la compétition 100% féminine et solidaire, ce raid est une occasion exceptionnelle de découvrir la beauté de la Martinique sous un autre angle.

programme.title: Good Morning Britain
programme.desc: Morning magazine featuring a lively mix of news and current affairs, plus health, entertainment and lifestyle features.

programme.title: This Morning
programme.desc: A mix of celebrity chat, lifestyle features, advice and competitions.

programme.title: ITV Lunchtime News; Weather
programme.desc: The key headlines from the day so far.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: David Dickinson and his team visit Peterborough, where Fay Rutter inspects a jewellery box, James Layte digs deep for a bargain buy, and Tracey Thackray-Howitt assesses tin-plate toys. Tim Hogarth is feeling the pressure as a mother and daughter team up to get as much cash as they can for their dream trip to New York.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as contestant Dennis tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Chris from Wells, Sonia from Epping, Clementine from London and Mark from Abergavenny pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: Join Stephen Mulhern as he looks back at Georgia and Matt's Deal or No Deal battles against the Banker - do they choose to take an offer from the Banker in exchange for what's in their boxes, or do they hold out until the end and be rewarded handsomely?

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Charity feels thwarted. Cain struggles. Ross likes the attention.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Maria confronts Gary with the photographic proof of his lies, Dylan accepts responsibility for Betsy's plight, Kit begs Sarah to share the blame, and Lauren encourages Ollie to pursue a job opportunity.

programme.title: Red Rock: STV Player Presents
programme.desc: Darren Kiely is discovered by the pier - he is badly beaten, and the Garda hope this is not a fresh feud between the Hennessys and the Kielys. But Michael Hennessy has something to hide about the attack. Meanwhile, the return of a familiar face can only mean trouble. Crime drama, with Jack Nolan.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: Twisted Twins
programme.desc: Police officers in Atlanta, USA investigate the brutal murder of Nikki Whitehead in her own home in January 2010 only to find their investigation leads them to her identical twin daughters Jasmiyah and Tasmiyah.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Desiree Burch, Nick Helm, Tez Ilyas and Sikisa join team leaders Chizzy Akudolu and Eddie Kadi to answer questions about black history. Jimmy Akingbola hosts.

programme.title: Love & Death
programme.desc: As their affair continues, Candy fears that she and Allan are at risk of breaking their first rule about having no feelings for each other. Candy also bristles at the news that Allan and Betty have signed up for a Christian marriage retreat. Drama, starring Elizabeth Olsen and Jesse Plemons.

programme.title: Inside the Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Documentary following chefs, engineers and hoteliers at the central London hotel as they pull off glittering events, luxury renovations and culinary challenges while battling to ensure that the heritage destination stands out in a fierce-five star market. As Michel Roux hosts the biggest dinner of the year, chef Oliver must manage a culinary crisis, while Alice prepares a £10,000 a night suite for a demanding guest, and twin engineers Alan and Trevor take a leap of faith to light up the Langham. Maureen Lipman narrates.

programme.desc: The chef explores Italy's deep south, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway.

While the Petersons' blended family rallies around the patriarch, the investigation quickly zeroes in on Michael's secret life, calling the couple's seemingly picture perfect marriage into question. Fact-based drama, starring Colin Firth and Toni Collette.

programme.title: The Staircase
programme.desc: After posting bail, Michael and his high-powered attorney David Rudolf piece together their defence, while considering an offer from Jean-Xavier de Lestrade, a French documentarian eager to profile the case. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Baseball
programme.desc: The Braves host the Padres in the final game of a four-game National League series at Truist Park. The Padres counter with right-handed starting pitcher Griffin Canning, while the Braves rely on Matt Olson who leads with home runs and RBIs.

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: The Utah Mammoth and the Vegas Golden Knights meet for Game 1 of the Western Conference First Round at T-Mobile Arena. Utah won the regular-season series 2-1, including a dominant 4-0 shutout on March 19. Jack Eichel leads Vegas with 90 points.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Mammoth face the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena in Game 2 of the West first round. Vegas leads 1-0 after a 4-2 win. Logan Cooley scored the first playoff goal in Utah history while Mark Stone tied it and the Knights pulled the victory away.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Golden Knights face the Mammoth in Game 3 of the West first round at Delta Center. The series is tied after Utah won Game 2. Mark Stone scored early, but Dylan Guenther got the lead for Utah. Logan Cooley later pounced on a rebound for the win.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Golden Knights face the Utah Mammoth in Game 4 in Utah. The Mammoth lead 2-1 after a Game 3 win. Jack Eichel and Nic Dowd scored late, but Vegas could not overcome an early deficit. Karel Vejmelka made 29 saves to preserve the Mammoth victory.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Mammoth play the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 5 of the West first round. The series is tied 2-2 after Vegas won Game 4. The Golden Knights scored 5-4 behind Shea Theodore's winning goal. Utah stormed back with four unanswered goals.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights face the Utah Mammoth in Game 6 of the West first round at Delta Center. Vegas leads 3-2 after winning Game 5. Pavel Dorofeyev recorded the sixth playoff hat trick in team history. Brett Howden scored the winner in second OT.
